findings.message: 7 eyebrow/kicker label(s) above headings: "PORTFOLIO & MONOGRAPH" above "NANANG ADITYA"; "FLAGSHIP ARCHIVES" above "SELECTED ENTERPRISE SYSTEMS"; "ITEM #01" above "JM-RISE (Jasa Marga Toll Road Constructi"; "ITEM #02" above "Aggregator Operasi"; "ITEM #03" above "JM-ACT (Jasa Marga Adukan Cermati Tuntas"
findings.fix: Delete them. If the label carried real information, fold it into the headline or the supporting sentence.

findings.message: Monospace type outside code: ui-monospace — e.g. "/ Software Engineer", "Home", "Projects", "Experience"
findings.fix: Set it in the text face. Monospace is for literal code inside <pre>/<code> only.

findings.message: 13 tiny uppercase letter-spaced labels (e.g. "PORTFOLIO & MONOGRAPH", "•", "INDONESIA", "FLAGSHIP ARCHIVES").
findings.fix: Use sentence-case text at a readable size, or delete the label.

findings.message: 18 thin rule(s)/divider line(s): header.fixed.top-0 1440px | section.pt-24.sm:pt-32 1440px | div.p-3.bg-[var(--surface)] 423px | section.section-padding.border-b 1440px
findings.fix: Delete. Separate with space, a tone change, or scale. Lines are only for real tables and form fields.
Define a surface by its fill (one tone step from the page) or leave the content unboxed.
Vary the composition; not every section is a card grid.

findings.message: Low-contrast text: "Built with React • Vite • TailwindCSS. V" 3.7:1 needs 4.5:1; "DIRECT DISPATCH" 3.7:1 needs 4.5:1; "Archival highway photography © Firzafp, " 3.7:1 needs 4.5:1; "Jakarta, Indonesia" 3.7:1 needs 4.5:1
findings.fix: Darken or lighten the text colour.

findings.message: 4 typefaces in use (EB Garamond, ui-monospace, Inter, Bebas Neue).
findings.fix: Two at most: one display, one text. Often one is enough.

findings.message: No video anywhere on the page.
findings.fix: Look for one honest clip with scripts/assets.mjs --video (the place, the material, the process) and use it as a muted loop with a poster frame. Defend its absence only if no clip fits the subject.
Nothing meant to be read goes below 13px.

findings.message: This page is served by a development server (Vite, webpack or Next in dev mode).
findings.fix: Run the last gate on the production build too (vite build && vite preview, next build && next start, or the built index.html): minifiers and bundlers change the CSS a visitor receives.
